fixes.explanation: A hidden inner room! Ooh, I love a secret hideout, friend. But Jesus says the owner “…will show you a large upper room, furnished and ready.” Large, upstairs, set up and waiting. Me, I once hid the last cookie so well I needed a search party to find it.

Bethany is a real place, baker, so I get why it popped up. But Jesus says, “…I will go ahead of you into Galilee.” Picking the wrong town is like showing up at the wrong house with a full tray of cookies, big smile, knocking away, and nobody's expecting you. The place is Galilee.

problems.problem: The mixing-bowl comparison is still flat, and the explanation mainly repeats that the room was not described as hidden.
The imagined mix-up is still flat, and the explanation mostly repeats that Jesus named Galilee, not Bethany.
